ownerRequirement: One Eva across voice, text, memory and commands.

architecture.ingress: Final original user transcripts admitted to the existing authorized household/private conversation core; social turns included.
architecture.output: Only core answers or previously authorized saved-result text are supplied to the speech renderer.
architecture.boundary: Listener RTP discarded unconditionally; native model backend handoffs rejected; renderer receives silence instead of user microphone input.
architecture.memory: Same core conversation storage, retrieved context and durable work. No new memory/planner or identity.

changes: Deduplicate turn IDs; reject conflicting replay; combine immediately adjoining unadmitted transcript fragments.
Bind speech permission to input generation; STOP and interruptions revoke stale speech without cancelling accepted durable work.
Wait for renderer readiness; preserve existing prefix buffer and 100ms output priming.
Farewell goes through core, then output completion before session close. Unknown playback stays unconfirmed.
Disable unnecessary media app/plugin initialization; bound speaker temporary storage to128MiB.

tests.independentReview: review_cursor: no remaining scoped code blockers

limits: Automated audio input and output capture; no physical hearing or native device ACK simulated.
Speech renderer may normalize or rephrase text; strict verbatim reproduction not established.
Every conversational turn now waits for the same core. Latency remains noticeable; no claim that prior fast local-smalltalk latency is retained.
Existing bounded, audience-scoped history is not an exhaustive activity ledger.

usage.developmentUsage: Includes additional synthesis, unsuccessful protocol probes and tests; separate from ongoing Eva runtime, no total credit estimate.

excludedProbes: Text output with v3 rejected by installed protocol.
Silent listener did not finalize user transcripts.

privacy: No private transcripts, raw audio, account material or task contents included.
